# kitchen_cabinet — ObjectModel reconstruction

3 links, 2 joints, 48 frames, 480 tracks.

## Joints

| door_hinge | revolute | body → door | (+0.000, -0.000, +1.000) | -0.0° … 82.4° | 1.000 | 0.01 | 0.04 | 0.33 |

## Links

| link | material | mass kg | size mm | replay rms mm |

| body | wood (fill 0.25) | 36.583 | 603 × 503 × 803 | 2.4 |
| door | wood (fill 0.25) | 0.519 | 303 × 25 × 451 | 2.458 |
| drawer | wood (fill 0.25) | 0.150 | 282 × 25 × 144 | 2.611 |

## How to read this

- **confidence**: BIC posterior of the joint type (fixed / prismatic / revolute).
- **axis ±° / pivot ±mm**: frame-bootstrap spread; large values mean the motion range was too small.
- **replay rms**: the exported MJCF is compiled in MuJoCo, driven with the estimated joint states, and every simulated surface point is compared with the observed tracks.
- Damping and friction cannot be identified from motion alone and are defaults.
